component.name: ThemeProvider
component.description: Supplies a light or dark theme to the components inside it. Renders no extra element.

props.name: theme
props.description: Light or dark appearance for descendant components.

props.name: children
props.description: Components that receive the selected theme.

providerInteraction.description: ZoomUIToolkitProvider passes its theme prop to the components inside it, and its notifications use the same theme. Set the theme there. Use ThemeProvider only to give part of your layout a different theme; notifications keep the provider's theme.
rules: ThemeProvider can supply light or dark to a custom subtree.
ThemeProvider renders no extra element. Components inside it follow its theme automatically; read the value with useTheme() to style your own elements.
